derivatives_disagreement.policy: FUNDING_DIRECTION_ONLY; venue funding intervals and venue-specific OI are not directly averaged.

provider.definition: Direct on-chain exchange-wallet inflow, outflow and netflow observations.
provider.name: CRYPTOQUANT_API

exchange_flow_intelligence.semantic_policy: Only a returned exchange-flow observation with timestamp and non-null netflow is SEMANTIC_DIRECT. Credentials/endpoints alone never count as coverage.

semantic_policy.CACHE: Cached/fallback evidence; retained with explicit penalty and never relabelled as live.
semantic_policy.LIVE_PROXY: Live evidence that is informative but does not directly measure the named concept.
semantic_policy.MISSING: Required evidence unavailable; no imputation or proxy relabelling.
semantic_policy.SEMANTIC_DIRECT: Available, non-cache evidence that directly measures the named evidence dimension.
